title: 'You Don't Want To Miss': Triptii Dimri Reviews Vir Das' Directorial Happy Patel | Bollywood News - News18
text: When some of the most talented names in the industry come together, a film is bound to grab attention. That is exactly what is happening with Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos. The film marks Vir Das ’ directorial debut and is backed by Aamir Khan as producer. With such strong creative forces behind it, the film has already begun earning praise from celebrities. Triptii Dimri recently took to Instagram to share her review of Vir Das’ directorial debut, and it is all praise. Triptii Dimri Is ‘Impressed’ With Vir’s Film On January 13, Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos had a star-studded screening that had everyone talking. Triptii Dimri was among the celebrities who attended and later took to social media to praise the film, adding to the growing excitement around Vir Das’ directorial debut. Taking to her Instagram story, Triptii shared a snippet from the film, and wrote, “Finally got to watch Happy Patel and I’m so impressed…the film is such a joy from start to finish." She urged her followers to watch the film in theatres and added, “Go catch it in cinemas on 16th January, you don’t want to miss this." Vir replied, “Thank you so much Triptii!" Triptii also posted a separate story for her friend Kavi Shastri, who has co-directed the film alongside Vir and wrote, “Big shoutout to my amazing friend Kavi Shastri. So proud of you and all the hard work you’ve put into this. #HappyPatel16Jan" Fatima Sana Shaikh Hails Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos Not just Triptii, Fatima Sana Shaikh also took to Instagram to share her review of the film. She wrote, “Just finished watching Happy Patel. Such a fun ride, full dhamaal! Congratulations to the team. Sabki kya badhiya performance hai! Ek se badhkar ek. All the best doston." About The Film All set to release on January 16, Happy Patel: Khatarnak Jasoos is directed by Vir Das and Kavi Shastri. It is written by Vir and Amog Ranadive. The film is bankrolled by Aamir Khan Productions. It stars Mona Singh, Sharib Hashmi, Srushti Tawade, and Mithila Palkar, alongside Vir.
